title: Age puberty starts in girls
answer: Most girls start puberty somewhere between about 8 and 13 years old. The first sign is usually small breast buds, then hair under the arms and around the genitals, a growth spurt and later the first period. Every girl has her own timing, so starting earlier or later than your friends is usually normal. If you have questions about your own timing, a nurse at your health center can check and reassure you.

title: Age puberty starts in boys
answer: Most boys start puberty somewhere between about 9 and 14 years old, often a little later than girls. The first sign is usually the testicles and scrotum getting bigger. After that come pubic hair, a bigger penis, a growth spurt, a deeper voice and later facial hair. Every boy has his own timing. If you are unsure about yours, a nurse at the health center can check you privately.

title: How long puberty lasts
answer: Puberty usually lasts several years, often about 4 to 5 years, but it can be shorter or longer. Changes come little by little, not all at once. For many girls it is mostly finished by around 15 to 17, and for many boys by around 16 to 18, though some boys keep growing and getting more facial hair into their early twenties.

title: What causes puberty to start
answer: Puberty starts when a part of your brain sends chemical messages, called hormones, to your body. In girls these messages tell the ovaries to make more estrogen. In boys they tell the testicles to make more testosterone. These hormones cause the changes you notice, like body hair, growth, breasts or a deeper voice. Nothing you do or eat switches it on. It happens naturally when your body is ready.

These hormones cause body changes and can also affect your feelings, energy and skin. Changing hormone levels are a normal part of growing up.

title: Food and puberty timing
answer: Good food helps your body grow and develop well. Young people who do not get enough food over a long time may start puberty later and grow less. Children who carry a lot of extra body weight may start a little earlier. There is no special food that makes puberty come faster or slower. Eating a mix of beans, vegetables, fruit, grains, and milk, eggs, fish or meat when you can supports healthy growth.

answer: Some girls or families try to stop breasts growing by pressing, binding tightly, or using hot objects on the chest.
